memory_candidates.content: Birelational BForces (exists-diamond + F1/F2, task 490) semantically characterizes CK+Cd+Idb, NOT bare CK: the plain exists-diamond clause validates Cd with no frame condition, and F2 validates Idb. Bare CK needs the Wijesekera forall-exists diamond clause over frames with no confluence conditions (CKForces/CKValid in Constructive/Forcing.lean).

MValid (Birelational.lean) is not sound for any logic containing efq unless explosion conditions are added: botForces is only required upward-closed, so bot->p is refuted by botForces=True, val=False. Fallible-model soundness needs val_expl/mreach_expl-style conditions (see EValid/CKValid).

ianshil/CK segment completeness needs no two-level tail fixpoint: tails are set comprehensions (maximal tail for ofHead/box case, restricted A-omitting tail for the diamond case), so only single-theory prime extensions via prime_exclusion at a trivial Cons are required.
